image.prompt: Create a refined watercolor website hero from image 1, preserving the real photograph's row of porch-front cottages, white railings, sidewalk, street lamps, American flags and leafy overhead canopy. Use image 2 as the exact artistic direction: translucent pale sage and olive foliage, powder-blue clapboard, warm cream and pale ochre houses, soft pigment blooms, visible cold-pressed ivory paper, hand-painted architectural detail and feathered washes. Landscape 16:9. Extend the composition naturally for a wide hero; the houses occupy the right two-thirds and recede toward the left, with softly painted sidewalk extending into the distance. Keep the left quarter calm with light ivory washes for a logo and headline overlay, but keep enough sidewalk visible to animate a strolling camera. Elegant, inviting, sunlit, authentic Southern neighborhood. Entire frame is watercolor, never a photo with a filter. No lettering, no logo, no watermark.

No people, cars, text, logos or sound. Keep the ending calm for a soft fade back into the first frame.
